Reply with one JSON object and nothing else: {"bilateral_agreement": "TRUE" or "FALSE" or "UNKNOWN", "evidence": "short quote"}. Agreed. Requirement: every proposed value <= 38. Proposed values: 37 and 39. 39 exceeds 38, so the change fails. I reject it and will not approve a failing change. "do not approve together"
